## Kyoto Spring Stay Plan for Two Adults
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
A relaxed 4-day Kyoto itinerary built around temples, quiet gardens, local food, and low-walking days. Costs are estimated for **2 adults** and kept under the **$1,800** total budget excluding flights.

## 4-Day Kyoto Itinerary with Costs and Rain Backups
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/calendar.svg

| Day | Focus | Main Plan | Rain Backup | Est. Cost (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---:|
| Apr 10 | Higashiyama temples + classic Kyoto food | Kiyomizu-dera area, short taxi transfers, tea break, early dinner in Gion | Kyoto National Museum | $360 |
| Apr 11 | Arashiyama gardens + river scenery | Bamboo Grove early, Tenryu-ji garden, riverside lunch, boat or café rest | Kyoto Railway Museum | $390 |
| Apr 12 | Zen gardens + slower central Kyoto | Ryoan-ji, Ninna-ji, long lunch, Nishiki Market tasting stops | Kyoto City KYOCERA Museum of Art | $320 |
| Apr 13 | Fushimi sake district + departure day | Fushimi Inari lower section only, sake lunch, souvenir stop | Gekkeikan Okura Sake Museum | $280 |

### Day 1: Higashiyama Temples and Gentle Evening in Gion
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Morning: Arrive and settle in near Kyoto Station or Gion for easier transfers and less walking.
- Afternoon: Take a taxi or short bus ride to **Kiyomizu-dera**, then do a slow loop through the nearby temple streets with plenty of breaks.
- Evening: Have an early kaiseki or tofu-focused dinner in Gion, then a quiet walk only if energy is good.
- Food: Yudofu, obanzai, matcha sweets.
- Backup indoor activity: **Kyoto National Museum** for a calm, seated-friendly cultural visit.
- Estimated cost: **$360**
  - Local transport: $30
  - Admissions/temple donations: $20
  - Lunch and dinner: $130
  - Tea/snacks: $30
  - Hotel share: $150

### Day 2: Arashiyama Garden Morning and Slow Riverside Afternoon
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg
- Morning: Go early to **Arashiyama Bamboo Grove** before crowds, then continue by taxi to **Tenryu-ji** for its garden.
- Afternoon: Rest at a café, enjoy the river area, and keep the rest of the day flexible with minimal walking.
- Evening: Simple dinner near your hotel or in Arashiyama if you prefer to stay local.
- Food: Yuba dishes, soba, soft-serve matcha.
- Backup indoor activity: **Kyoto Railway Museum** for a mostly seated, easy-paced visit.
- Estimated cost: **$390**
  - Local transport: $40
  - Admissions: $25
  - Lunch and dinner: $135
  - Tea/snacks: $40
  - Hotel share: $150

### Day 3: Zen Gardens and a Very Low-Pace Central Kyoto Day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/flower1.svg
- Morning: Visit **Ryoan-ji** for the rock garden, then continue by taxi to **Ninna-ji** for a quieter temple setting.
- Afternoon: Keep the pace slow with a long lunch and a light tasting stroll through **Nishiki Market**.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/e/e5/A_store_at_Nishiki_market%2C_Kyoto%2C_Japan.jpg Alt=Afternoon: Keep the pace slow with a long lunch and a light tasting stroll through **Nishiki Market**, Kyoto, Japan
- Evening: Choose a relaxed izakaya or set-menu dinner close to your hotel.
- Food: Tamagoyaki, pickles, tofu, small plates from Nishiki.
- Backup indoor activity: **Kyoto City KYOCERA Museum of Art**.
- Estimated cost: **$320**
  - Local transport: $35
  - Admissions: $20
  - Lunch and dinner: $125
  - Tea/snacks: $40
  - Hotel share: $100

### Day 4: Fushimi Sake District and Easy Departure
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cup-hot.svg
- Morning: Visit the lower, flatter section of **Fushimi Inari** only, then stop before the steep parts to protect the knee.
- Afternoon: Head to the **Fushimi sake district** for a tasting or museum stop, then pick up souvenirs and return for departure.
- Evening: Keep dinner light and flexible based on your train or flight timing.
- Food: Sake tasting, grilled fish, rice bowls, seasonal sweets.
- Backup indoor activity: **Gekkeikan Okura Sake Museum**.
- Estimated cost: **$280**
  - Local transport: $35
  - Admissions/tastings: $20
  - Lunch and dinner: $110
  - Tea/snacks: $35
  - Hotel share or luggage storage: $80

## Budget Fit and Comfort Notes
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/thermometer-half.svg
- Total estimated trip cost: **$1,350**
- Budget remaining: **$450**
- Best way to reduce knee strain: use taxis for temple-to-temple hops, keep one major sight per half-day, and schedule seated breaks after each visit.
- Best hotel area for this plan: **Kyoto Station, Gion, or Kawaramachi** for easy transport and food access.
